method: Local Schenk least-squares alignment; De Wit envelopes cross-registered through three common towns. No use of the previous Neckar affine north of Heidelberg.

polygons.territory: Conservative Rheingau strip, north of Rhine: not the entire Mainz state or Nassau/Hesse.
Aschaffenburg and inner Spessart fragment; excludes distant Lohr/Orb/Rieneck and southern Klingenberg/Miltenberg districts pending their own pass.
Otterberg-Lautern conservative northern raccord, already KPF: geographical subdivision only, outside Deux-Ponts and the Leiningen/Falkenstein fringes.

limitations: Schenk is catalogued after 1695 and De Wit after 1688. Confirmed continuing lordships are applied to conservative core envelopes only, not every old colour or county on these maps.
Local game-scale approximation: source-city and native-locator distortions remain several pixels. Cross-map remote Giessen check is not a validation of northern Hesse.
Mainz's old core x1141A0 remains unchanged and is not certified as a historical border. Full Bergstrasse, Lohr/Orb/Miltenberg and western palatine enclaves remain open.
No automatic merger of Electoral Palatinate, Bavaria, Deux-Ponts, Leiningen, Worms or Speyer. Untouched PRU/HES/BAV/KPF fringes are not certified as 1776 sovereignty.
Demographic transfers are conservative area-based gameplay allocations, not a historical census. Micro-enclaves below bitmap resolution remain abstracted.
